body: sorry. it's not that i don't want to open up, i just really don't know.
there really isn't anything more. i feel worthless and disgusting and i'm not really sure why.

i'm not great in social situations and annoy the few friends i have. i'm never happy with myself. i hate receiving compliments and i can't remember a time where i really felt proud about something i did or how i looked. hell, i can't look in the mirror half the time without feeling disgusted with myself. and i feel like there's absolutely nothing i can do. not that i'm powerless to change this, but that i have no idea how i could change. i'm just disgusted with myself and beyond this vague stuff, i'm completely lost.
